thread:
Maya: follow-up from the postmortem: we've had recurring noisy pages from the inference autoscaler. need owners for suppression, dedupe, and a simple metric guard.
Liam: root cause seems to be duplicate events when nodes drain. proposal: increase dedupe window to 10m, dedupe key include cluster_id, and suppress after 3 repeats in 5m.
Sara: agree. also add a metric guard so pages only fire if error_rate >5% for 2 consecutive 1m windows. keeps transient flaps quiet.
Maya: who can own each piece? target rollout by Friday EOD.
Ravi: I can own suppression rules and monitor. will open PR and canary to staging.
Liam: i'll update alert-router (dedupe key + window). will do region-by-region canary.
Sara: i'll add the metric guard and a short oncall playbook note (how to un-silence).
Deploy-Bot: CI started for branch auto/dedupe-window (build 4801)
Maya: list actions + ETAs here please for PM tracking.
Ravi: action: suppression policy update (owner: Ravi) ETA: 2025-03-12T18:00Z PR: https://git.internal/rw/infra/ops/1234
Liam: action: alert-router dedupe change (owner: Liam) ETA: 2025-03-12T16:00Z PR: https://git.internal/rw/router/987
Sara: action: metric guard + playbook blurb (owner: Sara) ETA: 2025-03-13T12:00Z PR: https://git.internal/rw/monitoring/555
Maya: we'll tag future pages with label "inference-noise" and run weekly sweeps for 4 weeks. owner for sweep: Maya/SRE rotation.
Liam: note: when changing dedupe key, old buckets won't match; expect some initial pages. plan controlled rollout.
Sara: added rollback steps in PR and a short runbook snippet for quick un-silence.
Ravi: PR opened with canary to us-west-2, smoke tests included. tagging @oncall-team
Liam: PR opened for router changes; canary to us-west first.
Sara: PR opened for monitoring + playbook docs path docs/oncall/auto-suppression.md
Maya: thanks all. i'll run the first weekly sweep next Monday and report back. ping here if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
